title: Things That Hold Time
method: Individually inspected every full candidate image with view_image after downloading and re-encoding through the existing private preview tool.

works.title: The Station Between Tides
works.rationale: The tide channel and amber arches establish a legible route through blue-hour space. Salt marks and two waiting figures carry civic time without lettering; strong warm-cool separation and a coherent vanishing point distinguish this architectural work.

works.title: A Face Borrowed from Tomorrow
works.rationale: The close portrait and tarnished mirror sustain one convincing impossible age shift. Natural skin detail, pearl fabric and the restrained older smile create an intimate temporal tension; the face remains coherent rather than fragmented.

works.title: The Garden Keeps the Scar
works.rationale: A pale diagonal root organizes charred soil, fungal threads and small seedlings. The opalescent leaf provides one focal accent while burned trunks preserve damage; detailed ecological texture supports the theme without concealing the scar.

works.title: Six Beats and a Missing Seventh
works.rationale: Six cobalt beats sit above an extended empty field. Thin violet lines and the isolated yellow counterweight create a deliberately incomplete rhythm; flat print texture and exact shape hierarchy give the collection a distinct abstract register.

works.title: After the Lantern Passed
works.rationale: The fading green particle wake leads into a dark descent while the lower stair fixes depth. Leaving the animal absent makes the trace itself the subject; restrained luminance and layered water remain readable at gallery scale.

works.title: A Road Remembered Only by Rain
works.rationale: The rain-washed central absence redirects terracotta routes around an otherwise detailed terrain. Symbol-only margins, graphite contours and worn vellum sustain a coherent imagined atlas; the blank region is an active compositional landmark.

works.title: The Knot Holds the Room
works.rationale: Directional linen folds converge into a rust-red knot and open into a suspended basin. Visible seams and tension make the textile structure legible; side light and the floor gap give the work weight, scale and convincing material presence.

works.title: Someone Left the Warm Cup
works.rationale: The warm cup, peeled pear and indigo cloth are carefully spaced around a wet empty ring. Window light, steam and scratched wood imply a recent act of care; the absent cup carries narrative without added decorative props.

works.title: Maintenance at First Light
works.rationale: The severe pump silhouette is softened by dawn and accumulated wear. An open service panel exposes a readable impeller and tools; the ladder connects human scale to monumental machinery, making repair the organizing idea.

works.title: The Orchard Inside the Thimble
works.rationale: Three miniature apricot trees, a tiny ladder and a much larger fallen fruit create a clear scale surprise. Tarnished metal, model-sized foliage and soft peach light make the orchard tactile and readable, with a distinct playful tone.

works.title: The Field After the Sound
works.rationale: A low salt-field horizon gives the storm room to recede. The narrow apricot reflection guides the eye beneath slate rain curtains; rough mineral ground and clearing light carry calm as a consequence of weather.

works.title: The Seam Is a Coastline
works.rationale: The exposed torn paper edge joins magnified leaf veins to tidal channels without disguising the scale change. Petrol green and copper fragments unify the two systems; real material texture gives this ecological collage a distinct visual language.

limits: Originality judged within this collection, not certified against all existing art.
Titles are residency catalog labels; public gallery contract remains image and Star attribution only.
